name: Marin Country Mart
summary: Marin Country Mart is an upscale open-air lifestyle center in Larkspur featuring a sophisticated mix of contemporary fashion boutiques, artisanal dining destinations, and wellness services. The center serves as a community hub with its popular Saturday farmer's market and offers an elevated shopping experience with brands like Jenni Kayne, Goop, and Design Within Reach alongside acclaimed restaurants like Hog Island Oyster Co.
demographics: Marin Country Mart attracts an affluent, educated demographic primarily consisting of families and professionals aged 30-65 with household incomes exceeding $150,000. The trade area draws from Marin County's upscale communities including Larkspur, Corte Madera, and Mill Valley, where residents prioritize quality, sustainability, and curated shopping experiences. Visitors are typically health-conscious, environmentally aware consumers who value artisanal products, organic dining options, and boutique retail over mass-market chains. The Saturday farmer's market attracts a multi-generational crowd including young families with children seeking community-oriented activities and premium local goods.
description: Marin Country Mart is a premier lifestyle destination in Larkspur, California, offering a carefully curated collection of upscale boutiques, artisanal dining, and wellness experiences in an inviting open-air setting. This sophisticated shopping center has established itself as Marin County's go-to destination for discerning shoppers, featuring an impressive roster of contemporary fashion brands including Jenni Kayne, James Perse, Veronica Beard, and Dôen, alongside luxury home goods retailers like Design Within Reach and Hudson Grace. The center's commitment to quality extends to its exceptional dining scene, which ranges from the beloved Hog Island Oyster Co. and Le Marais Bistro to health-focused options like SunLife Organics and Pressed, plus the popular Shake Shack for casual fare. Beyond shopping and dining, Marin Country Mart serves as a community hub with its celebrated Saturday morning farmer's market featuring local crafts and live music, complemented by fitness offerings including SoulCycle, Mighty Pilates, and Love Story Yoga. With premium services like International Orange Spa, Barber Lane, and even a Fidelity Investments office, this thoughtfully designed center caters to every aspect of the modern Marin lifestyle, making it a beloved gathering place for locals and visitors alike.
